result.summary: Optimizes the `deterministic-fuzz-coverage` developer tool by comparing merged `.profdata` profile files directly between runs and skipping expensive `llvm-cov show` report rendering when profiles match. If profile data differs, the tool falls back to rendering and diffing coverage reports to pinpoint non-determinism. It also switches the parallelism argument from positional to `--parallelism=<value>`.
result.problem: Generating human-readable `llvm-cov show` coverage reports for every fuzz input across two separate runs dominates the runtime of fuzz coverage determinism checks, even though almost all inputs produce identical reports that are discarded.
evidence: Author benchmarks showing a ~3x speedup on qa-assets corpora: `addition_overflow` dropped from 32s to 10s, and `process_message` dropped from 719s to 247s (PR description).
On `process_message`, all 2,386 inputs took the fast path, eliminating 4,772 `llvm-cov show` report invocations (PR description).
result.changed_since_previous: Switched the parallelism CLI argument from a positional parameter to a named `--parallelism=<value>` option in the tool and documentation.
result.card: This PR optimizes the `deterministic-fuzz-coverage` devtool by comparing merged `.profdata` files directly between runs and skipping `llvm-cov show` rendering when profiles match byte-for-byte. This cuts execution time by roughly 3x for fuzz coverage determinism checks on large corpora (e.g., from ~12 minutes to ~4 minutes on process_message) by only rendering human-readable reports when a discrepancy is detected. It also updates the tool's CLI to accept `--parallelism=<value>` as a named flag.

risk.why: Touches only an internal developer tool in contrib/devtools, with no impact on node binaries, tests, or consensus.
